priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Apply Flame Shock to your primary target using Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock.
Drop Surging Totem on cooldown and ensure it remains active.
Use Sundering if Whirling Earth is active or if you have the Surging Elements talent.
Use Lava Lash if Whirling Fire is active to consume the buff.
Cast Ascendance and Doom Winds during your burst window alongside offensive trinkets and racials.
Use Crash Lightning if Whirling Air is active and either Doom Winds or Ascendance is up (Thorim's Invocation).
Use Windstrike or Stormstrike while Whirling Air is active to benefit from Thorim's Invocation.
Cast Tempest when you reach 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Primordial Storm when you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Spend Maelstrom Weapon stacks on Chain Lightning, ideally at 9-10 stacks, or at 5+ stacks if no other priority is available.
Use Voltaic Blaze whenever it is available as a priority filler.
Use Crash Lightning to maintain its cleave buff and as a general AoE filler.
Use Lava Lash as your primary melee filler when other high-priority abilities are on cooldown.
Use Stormstrike if you have nearly two full charges or have reached maximum stacks of Converging Storms.
